title: "SPARQL Query Builder DSL"

## Overview

RDFLib.jl provides a fluent SPARQL query builder that lets you construct queries programmatically using Julia's pipe (`|>`) operator. Instead of writing SPARQL strings manually, you build queries step by step with type-safe functions.

```{julia}
using RDFLib

# Build a sample graph to query against
g = RDFGraph()
ex = Namespace("http://example.org/")
foaf = Namespace("http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/")
bind!(g, "ex", ex)
bind!(g, "foaf", foaf)

add!(g, Triple(ex("alice"), RDF.type, foaf("Person")))
add!(g, Triple(ex("alice"), foaf("name"), Literal("Alice")))
add!(g, Triple(ex("alice"), foaf("age"), Literal(30)))
add!(g, Triple(ex("alice"), foaf("knows"), ex("bob")))
add!(g, Triple(ex("alice"), foaf("knows"), ex("carol")))
add!(g, Triple(ex("bob"), RDF.type, foaf("Person")))
add!(g, Triple(ex("bob"), foaf("name"), Literal("Bob")))
add!(g, Triple(ex("bob"), foaf("age"), Literal(25)))
add!(g, Triple(ex("bob"), foaf("knows"), ex("alice")))
add!(g, Triple(ex("carol"), RDF.type, foaf("Person")))
add!(g, Triple(ex("carol"), foaf("name"), Literal("Carol")))
add!(g, Triple(ex("carol"), foaf("age"), Literal(35)))
add!(g, Triple(ex("carol"), ex("city"), Literal("London")))
println("Graph has $(length(g)) triples")
```

## SELECT Queries

Build SELECT queries by chaining `select`, `where`, and modifier functions.

```{julia}
# Simple SELECT — find all person names
q = SelectQuery() |>
    q -> prefix(q, "foaf", "http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/") |>
    q -> select(q, :name) |>
    q -> where(q, :person, "foaf:name", :name)

# View the generated SPARQL
println(build(q))
```

```{julia}
# Execute against our graph
results = execute(q, g)
for row in results
    println("  Name: ", row[:name])
end
```

## Adding Patterns and Filters

Chain multiple `where` calls for additional triple patterns, and use `filter` for constraints.

```{julia}
# Find people older than 28
q = SelectQuery() |>
    q -> prefix(q, "foaf", "http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/") |>
    q -> select(q, :name, :age) |>
    q -> where(q, :person, "rdf:type", "foaf:Person") |>
    q -> where(q, :person, "foaf:name", :name) |>
    q -> where(q, :person, "foaf:age", :age) |>
    q -> filter(q, "?age > 28")

println(build(q))
println()
results = execute(q, g)
for row in results
    println("  $(row[:name]) (age $(row[:age]))")
end
```

## OPTIONAL Patterns

Use `optional` for patterns that may or may not match.

```{julia}
# Find all people with optional city
q = SelectQuery() |>
    q -> prefix(q, "foaf", "http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/") |>
    q -> prefix(q, "ex", "http://example.org/") |>
    q -> select(q, :name, :city) |>
    q -> where(q, :person, "foaf:name", :name) |>
    q -> optional(q, (:person, "ex:city", :city))

println(build(q))
println()
results = execute(q, g)
for row in results
    city = get(row, :city, "N/A")
    println("  $(row[:name]) — $(city)")
end
```

## ORDER BY, LIMIT, and OFFSET

Control result ordering and pagination.

```{julia}
# People sorted by age, descending, limit to 2
q = SelectQuery() |>
    q -> prefix(q, "foaf", "http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/") |>
    q -> select(q, :name, :age) |>
    q -> where(q, :person, "foaf:name", :name) |>
    q -> where(q, :person, "foaf:age", :age) |>
    q -> order_by(q, :age, :desc) |>
    q -> limit(q, 2)

println(build(q))
println()
results = execute(q, g)
for row in results
    println("  $(row[:name]) — age $(row[:age])")
end
```

## DISTINCT

Eliminate duplicate results.

```{julia}
# Distinct types in the graph
q = SelectQuery() |>
    q -> select(q, :type) |>
    q -> where(q, :s, "rdf:type", :type) |>
    q -> distinct(q)

println(build(q))
println()
results = execute(q, g)
for row in results
    println("  Type: ", row[:type])
end
```

## GROUP BY and HAVING

Aggregate results with grouping.

```{julia}
# Count friends per person
q = SelectQuery() |>
    q -> prefix(q, "foaf", "http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/") |>
    q -> select(q, :name) |>
    q -> where(q, :person, "foaf:name", :name) |>
    q -> where(q, :person, "foaf:knows", :friend) |>
    q -> group_by(q, :name) |>
    q -> having(q, "COUNT(?friend) > 1")

println(build(q))
```

## BIND Expressions

Compute new values from existing bindings.

```{julia}
# Compute age category
q = SelectQuery() |>
    q -> prefix(q, "foaf", "http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/") |>
    q -> select(q, :name, :category) |>
    q -> where(q, :person, "foaf:name", :name) |>
    q -> where(q, :person, "foaf:age", :age) |>
    q -> query_bind(q, "IF(?age >= 30, \"senior\", \"junior\")", :category)

println(build(q))
```

## VALUES Clause

Inject a fixed set of bindings.

```{julia}
# Only look up specific people
q = SelectQuery() |>
    q -> prefix(q, "foaf", "http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/") |>
    q -> prefix(q, "ex", "http://example.org/") |>
    q -> select(q, :person, :name) |>
    q -> where(q, :person, "foaf:name", :name) |>
    q -> query_values(q, [:person], [["ex:alice"], ["ex:bob"]])

println(build(q))
```

## UNION Patterns

Match alternative graph patterns.

```{julia}
# Find people who know someone OR have a city
q = SelectQuery() |>
    q -> prefix(q, "foaf", "http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/") |>
    q -> prefix(q, "ex", "http://example.org/") |>
    q -> select(q, :person, :name) |>
    q -> where(q, :person, "foaf:name", :name) |>
    q -> union_pattern(q,
        [(:person, "foaf:knows", :other)],
        [(:person, "ex:city", :city)])

println(build(q))
```

## MINUS Patterns

Exclude certain matches.

```{julia}
# Find people who do NOT know anyone
q = SelectQuery() |>
    q -> prefix(q, "foaf", "http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/") |>
    q -> select(q, :name) |>
    q -> where(q, :person, "rdf:type", "foaf:Person") |>
    q -> where(q, :person, "foaf:name", :name) |>
    q -> minus(q, (:person, "foaf:knows", :anyone))

println(build(q))
println()
results = execute(q, g)
for row in results
    println("  Loner: ", row[:name])
end
```

## CONSTRUCT Queries

Build new RDF graphs from query results.

```{julia}
# Construct a simplified graph
q = ConstructQuery() |>
    q -> prefix(q, "foaf", "http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/") |>
    q -> prefix(q, "ex", "http://example.org/") |>
    q -> construct(q, (:person, "ex:hasName", :name)) |>
    q -> where(q, :person, "foaf:name", :name)

println(build(q))
```

## ASK Queries

Check if a pattern exists.

```{julia}
# Does anyone know Alice?
q = AskQuery() |>
    q -> prefix(q, "ex", "http://example.org/") |>
    q -> prefix(q, "foaf", "http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/") |>
    q -> where(q, :someone, "foaf:knows", "ex:alice")

println(build(q))
```

## DESCRIBE Queries

Get a description of resources.

```{julia}
q = DescribeQuery() |>
    q -> prefix(q, "ex", "http://example.org/") |>
    q -> describe(q, "ex:alice")

println(build(q))
```

## Summary

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `SelectQuery()` | Start a SELECT query |
| `ConstructQuery()` | Start a CONSTRUCT query |
| `AskQuery()` | Start an ASK query |
| `DescribeQuery()` | Start a DESCRIBE query |
| `prefix(q, name, uri)` | Add PREFIX declaration |
| `select(q, vars...)` | Set SELECT variables |
| `where(q, s, p, o)` | Add triple pattern |
| `filter(q, expr)` | Add FILTER constraint |
| `optional(q, patterns...)` | Add OPTIONAL block |
| `union_pattern(q, left, right)` | Add UNION |
| `minus(q, patterns...)` | Add MINUS |
| `query_bind(q, expr, var)` | Add BIND expression |
| `query_values(q, vars, rows)` | Add VALUES clause |
| `group_by(q, vars...)` | GROUP BY clause |
| `having(q, expr)` | HAVING condition |
| `order_by(q, var, dir)` | ORDER BY clause |
| `limit(q, n)` | LIMIT results |
| `offset(q, n)` | OFFSET results |
| `distinct(q)` | DISTINCT modifier |
| `build(q)` | Render to SPARQL string |
| `execute(q, graph)` | Execute and return results |
